title: SK Hynix Nasdaq debut: $26.5 billion ADR listing sets record, ADR opens +14% at $170
summary: SK Hynix raised $26.5B via Nasdaq ADR offering (ticker SKHYV, permanent SKHY), the largest-ever U.S. listing by a foreign company, surpassing Alibaba's 2014 record. ADRs priced at $149 each, opened at $170, and closed with ~13% gain on heavy demand (7x oversubscribed).
why: 存储芯片超级周期的资本市场里程碑；SK海力士大规模赴美融资验证AI内存需求强劲，对美光(MU)估值有正面参照意义；同日CEO发出2027短缺预警，有望抬升整体存储板块估值预期。

title: SK Hynix CEO warns of worst-ever memory shortage in 2027, demand to outstrip supply beyond 2030
summary: SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung, speaking on Nasdaq listing day, said memory demand will exceed the company's supply capacity well into the next decade. Jensen Huang of Nvidia echoed the view; UBS sees DRAM undersupply through at least Q2 2028.
why: 供需失衡长期化论断支撑HBM定价权和ASP上行预期，直接利好美光(MU)和SK海力士相关港股ETF(7709.HK)；对卖出期权的IV有正向支撑。

title: Shein wins Chinese regulator approval for Hong Kong IPO, targets $40-50B valuation
summary: China's CSRC on July 10 approved Shein's long-awaited Hong Kong IPO (after failed London and New York bids). Shein plans to sell up to 341.6M H shares; valuation target is $40-50B, down sharply from the $100B peak in 2022.
why: 港股市场重大IPO事件，有望提振市场情绪和互联网消费板块流动性；估值较峰值已大幅折让，定价区间值得关注。

title: Fed semi-annual report: inflation rose due to Iran war, tariffs, AI infrastructure costs; rate held at 3.5-3.75%
summary: The Federal Reserve's July 2026 semi-annual monetary policy report, the first under Chair Kevin Warsh, found inflation moved higher this spring due to Iran war, tariffs, and soaring AI-related technology costs. The Fed reaffirmed its price-stability commitment while keeping the federal funds rate at 3.5-3.75%.
why: 宏观利率路径再次被锁定偏鹰方向，对sell put策略隐含波动率定价有影响；AI基建通胀成新因素值得关注，提示科技板块估值与通胀交叉风险。

title: Trump: Iran ceasefire is 'OVER' but U.S. agreed to resume talks; Brent crude near $76, Hormuz risk premium persists
summary: Trump declared the U.S.-Iran ceasefire finished after tanker attacks in Hormuz, but said Washington agreed to Iran's request to continue talks (next round possibly in Switzerland next week). Brent crude closed ~$76/barrel with ~5% weekly gain. Dow fell 577pts on July 8; markets partially stabilized on July 10 on talk-resumption news.
why: 地缘局势牵动油价与全球风险偏好；霍尔木兹风险溢价支撑航运、能源板块；若谈判取得进展油价回落有利于控通胀，降低美联储鹰派压力。

title: Apple sues OpenAI for trade secret theft over AI hardware designs; OpenAI denies
summary: Apple filed suit in N. California federal court alleging OpenAI's hardware chief (former Apple VP Tang Tan) directed job candidates to bring confidential Apple materials to interviews, and an ex-Apple engineer took an Apple laptop with confidential AI hardware documents to OpenAI. Apple demands destruction of stolen materials.
why: 科技大厂AI硬件人才与知识产权争夺白热化；对OpenAI IPO前景和合规风险有潜在影响；谷歌(GOOGL)、英伟达等受AI人才战波及的科技股需关注监管层面的连锁效应。

title: 长征十号乙首飞成功：全球首次运载火箭海上网系回收，A股商业航天板块批量涨停
summary: 7月10日，长征十号乙运载火箭在海南商业航天发射场成功首飞，一子级在海上回收平台实现垂直返回，为全球首创海上网系回收技术。消息刺激A股商业航天概念股批量涨停，优机股份、航天环宇、中国卫通等多股封板。
why: 国内商业航天里程碑事件，可与SpaceX Falcon 9回收技术类比，重塑市场对中国商业航天竞争力预期；A股相关概念ETF及配套链条值得关注。
source: 新浪财经 / 证券时报

title: SanDisk (SNDK) surges ~10% as leaked Meta memo confirms multi-year flash storage supply deal; Meta to double compute to 14GW by 2027
summary: A leaked internal Meta memorandum revealed long-term supply agreements with SanDisk, Samsung, and Sumitomo Electric to support Meta's plan to double AI compute capacity to 14GW by 2027 (from 7GW in 2026), with capex projected up to $145B. SanDisk shares spiked ~10% on the news.
why: 直接利好持仓标的闪迪(SNDK)；Meta超大规模NAND采购锁定中长期供需，SanDisk作为独家命名方需求可见度大幅提升，期权隐含波动率短期或随股价暴涨而回落，适合观察covered call机会。

title: 腾讯7月9日HKEX披露：回购110万股，耗资HK$5.007亿，年内累计回购规模持续扩大
summary: 腾讯控股(0700.HK)于7月9日通过港交所回购110万股，成交价格区间HK$467.4-473.2，总耗资约HK$5亿。自5月13日股东大会授权10%回购上限（约9.12亿股）后，腾讯几乎每日回购。
why: 持续高强度回购支撑股价下方支撑；累计回购规模体现管理层对当前估值的认可，降低持仓downside风险，对卖出put价差策略有保护意义。

title: Xiaomi officially unveils Sky Nomad (鹏程) EREV brand; first model N90 full-size SUV targets 1,500km range, ~RMB200K price
summary: Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun announced 'Sky Nomad' (Chinese: 鹏程) as the brand name for its extended-range EV series. The first model, the N90 full-size SUV (5.3m length, EREV powertrain), targets a combined range exceeding 1,500km and a starting price ~RMB200K. Tech launch event expected end-July; market debut mid-to-late August. Competes directly with Li Auto and Huawei-backed Aito.
why: 小米汽车第三款产品线提前落地，EREV路线直攻Li Auto/问界优势市场；出行多品类布局强化1810.HK长期增长逻辑，短期关注8月发布会前后情绪催化。

title: DeepSeek begins in-house AI chip development to reduce reliance on Nvidia and Huawei — Reuters
summary: DeepSeek has quietly increased hiring of chip-design engineers and is reaching out to foundry and memory partners to develop its own inference chip, reducing dependence on Nvidia's sanctioned chips and Huawei's Ascend. The project is early-stage; Nvidia fell ~1.6% intraday on the report but NVDA China revenue had already fallen to near zero due to export controls.
why: 短期对英伟达(NVDA)情绪有边际负面影响；长期看中国AI生态自研化是结构性趋势，可能影响Nvidia中国市场的长期恢复预期；对HBM供应链（美光/SK海力士）的中国订单亦有潜在影响。

title: Intel (INTC) crashes 21% in one week: 18A yield delays push profitable production to late 2026-2027; AMD overtakes Intel in data center revenue for first time
summary: INTC fell 7.67% on July 8 to ~$110.68, extending a 21% weekly slide. The catalyst: reports that 18A yield stability won't reach profitability until late 2026 or 2027. AMD recorded its first-ever quarterly data center revenue lead over Intel. Counterpoint: BlueFin Research says Intel has resolved yield variability on 18A at ~30,000 wafers/month. Q2 earnings due July 23.
why: 英特尔持仓重要事件——18A延迟叠加AMD首次超越，竞争格局加速恶化；7月23日Q2财报是下一个催化剂，期权隐含波动率可能居高；若有sell put仓位需评估风险。
